name: Duotone
description: The scene behind the window is blurred and then remapped onto a two-colour gradient by brightness, for the concert-poster look. Shadows take the first colour and highlights the second. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the gradient.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the window is blurred (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the duotone backdrop

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: How sharply brightness splits between the two colours, where 1.0 is a linear blend

parameters.name: Shadow colour
parameters.description: Colour the darkest parts of the scene map to

parameters.name: Highlight colour
parameters.description: Colour the brightest parts of the scene map to

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the blur that hides banding in smooth gradients
